runtime_basis: The approved episode slot is 30 minutes.
unit_objective: Complete the unit's assigned local task while advancing one approved season dependency.

opening_hook.promise: An ordinary assignment exposes a consequence the team cannot ignore.
opening_hook.function: Orient the local task and its connection to the continuing pressure.

scenes.title: Assignment under changed conditions
scenes.summary: The team begins the assigned task and recognizes the first concrete obstacle.
scenes.story_function: Orient the unit objective and establish a testable problem.
scenes.retention_function: A specific task and consequence create anticipation without hiding orientation.

scenes.title: The first plan changes
scenes.summary: The attempted solution exposes a second pressure and forces a choice between objectives.
scenes.story_function: Turn information into changed strategy and relationship terms.
scenes.retention_function: The choice narrows options while preserving a legible local goal.

scenes.title: Local completion and carried consequence
scenes.summary: The revised plan completes the task at a cost that changes the continuing plotline.
scenes.story_function: Resolve the unit promise and establish durable consequence.
scenes.retention_function: Earned completion makes the changed future condition meaningful.

event_coverage.outcome: The assigned task and its first obstacle become actionable.
The initial strategy changes under a second pressure.
The local task closes and creates one durable consequence.

plotline_coverage.advancement: The renewable task moves from assignment through changed strategy to local completion.
The continuing pressure changes the cost and future operating condition.

emotional_turns.change: The obstacle makes the ordinary method insufficient.
The team accepts a costly revised plan without resolving every disagreement.
The task succeeds, but its cost changes the next collaboration.

act_outs.changed_pressure: The team must choose a costlier plan before the task can continue.

midpoint.function: The failed method changes both strategy and the meaning of success.

climax.function: The revised plan is tested through decisive action and consequence.

resolution.unit_change: The team carries a new obligation into the continuing plotline.

forward_hook.promise: The next unit must address the obligation created by this success.
forward_hook.dependency: Carry PROJECT-PL02 forward without reopening PROJECT-PL01's completed task.

format_plan.local_resolution: The assigned task is completed within this episode.

season_dependencies.dependency: The cost of the revised plan changes the team's available options.
season_dependencies.carry_forward: The next assigned episode inherits the reduced option set and qualified trust.

uncertainties: Replace this generic uncertainty with the exact unresolved source fact.
